topic: Asking a Friend about the Wedding Gift Registry

script.title: THE WEDDING GIFT
script.scene_zh: 客廳 · 討論婚禮禮物
script.story_hook: Wedding season means one thing: gift stress.
script.intro_zh: 婚禮季節意味著一件事：禮物焦慮。
script.welcome_en: Hey, today we're at a friend's living room. Listen for gift chat phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嘿，今天我們在一位朋友的客廳。留意討論禮物的說法。
script.outro: That's the registry sorted. Listen again and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 禮單問題就這樣搞定了。再聽一次，大聲跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: Do I just buy the blender
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her early thirties with long straight dark brown hair worn in a single side braid, small round wire glasses, a dusty pink cardigan over a plain white tee, a delicate gold pendant necklace, and a petite build
script.char_b_description: a cheerful young man in his late twenties with buzzed black hair, a thin scruffy goatee, a faded navy college sports hoodie, ripped jeans, an athletic build, and a phone always in hand

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm so glad you have a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm soʊ ɡlæd ju hæv ə ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，很高興你有空。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries at all. Wedding stuff?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɝiz ət ˈɔl ˈwɛdɪŋ stʌf/
dialogue.zh: 完全不擔心。婚禮的事？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, um, I have a gift question.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛə ʌm aɪ hæv ə ɡɪft ˈkwɛstʃən/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我有一個關於禮物的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh wow, about the registry?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ waʊ əˈbaʊt ðə ˈrɛdʒɪstri/
dialogue.zh: 噢，是禮單的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! I looked but can't find the link.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ lʊkt bʌt kænt faɪnd ðə lɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 對！我找了但找不到連結。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's on the wedding site, under gifts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɑn ðə ˈwɛdɪŋ saɪt ˈʌndɚ ɡɪfts/
dialogue.zh: 在婚禮網站上，禮物那個欄位下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which tab? I see three at the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ tæb aɪ si θri ət ðə tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 哪個分頁？上面我看到三個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The middle one, it literally says registry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɪdəl wʌn ɪt ˈlɪtɚəli sɛz ˈrɛdʒɪstri/
dialogue.zh: 中間那個，上面直接寫了禮單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, there it is. Okay, I see items now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðɛr ɪt ɪz oʊˈkeɪ aɪ si ˈaɪtəmz naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 噢找到了。好，我看到商品了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you spot something you liked?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju spɑt ˈsʌmθɪŋ ju laɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 有沒有看到喜歡的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, there's a blender. It's two hundred dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðɛrz ə ˈblɛndɚ ɪts tu ˈhʌndrəd ˈdɑlərz/
dialogue.zh: 有個果汁機，要兩百塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, don't buy that, skip it.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ doʊnt baɪ ðæt skɪp ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，別買那個，跳過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I just buy the blender?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ dʒʌst baɪ ðə ˈblɛndɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那我到底要不要買果汁機？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No way! They have cheaper stuff down there.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ weɪ ðeɪ hæv ˈtʃipɚ stʌf daʊn ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 不用啦！下面有便宜很多的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like what, um, towels?
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk wʌt ʌm ˈtaʊəlz/
dialogue.zh: 比如說，嗯，毛巾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yeah, a nice towel set, about thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛə ə naɪs ˈtaʊəl sɛt əˈbaʊt ˈθɜrti/
dialogue.zh: 對，一套好毛巾，大概三十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, that fits my budget much better.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðæt fɪts maɪ ˈbʌdʒɪt mʌtʃ ˈbɛɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好，那樣我負擔得起多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The candle trio is cute too, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkændəl ˈtraɪoʊ ɪz kjuːt tu ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 三入蠟燭組也很可愛，說真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, candles... does that feel like a real gift?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ˈkændəlz dʌz ðæt fil laɪk ə ˈɹiəl ɡɪft/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，蠟燭⋯⋯感覺像真正的禮物嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I mean, they might like something cozy.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ min ðeɪ maɪt laɪk ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈkoʊzi/
dialogue.zh: 我是說，他們也許喜歡溫馨的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, is there a way to give cash?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪz ðɛr ə weɪ tə ɡɪv kæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 那，可以直接給現金嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yeah, they set up a group fund.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛə ðeɪ sɛt ʌp ə ɡrup fʌnd/
dialogue.zh: 有，他們設了一個共同基金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh really? Is that considered polite, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ˈɹili ɪz ðæt kənˈsɪdɚd pəˈlaɪt ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那樣算禮貌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally, most couples prefer that nowadays.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊɾəli moʊst ˈkʌpəlz prɪˈfɝ ðæt ˈnaʊədeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 完全沒問題，現在多數新人都比較喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I just add, like, a small amount?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ dʒʌst æd laɪk ə smɔl əˈmaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 我可以只出一小部分嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, it's a group thing, everyone chips in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ɪts ə ɡrup θɪŋ ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn tʃɪps ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 當然，這是大家合力湊的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that's smart, so nobody buys the blender alone.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts smɑɹt soʊ ˈnoʊbədi baɪz ðə ˈblɛndɚ əˈloʊn/
dialogue.zh: 噢聰明，那沒人需要獨自買果汁機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, ten people pay twenty, they get it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli tɛn ˈpipəlz peɪ ˈtwɛnti ðeɪ ɡɛt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，十個人各出二十塊，他們就能收到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I love that. How do I tap it?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv ðæt haʊ du aɪ tæp ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡這個。要怎麼操作？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just click the fund, then pick your amount.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst klɪk ðə fʌnd ðɛn pɪk jɔɹ əˈmaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 點基金，然後選金額就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I do it today or is there time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ du ɪt təˈdeɪ ɔɹ ɪz ðɛr taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我該今天處理還是還有時間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any time before the wedding, but sooner is easier.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni taɪm bɪˈfɔɹ ðə ˈwɛdɪŋ bʌt ˈsuːnɚ ɪz ˈizɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 婚禮之前任何時間都行，但越早越輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Oh wait, does it ship to their place?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt oʊ weɪt dʌz ɪt ʃɪp tə ðɛɹ pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 好。對了，會送到他們那裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yup, everything goes straight to their new place.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʌp ˈɛvɹiˌθɪŋ ɡoʊz streɪt tə ðɛr nju pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 對，所有東西直接送到他們新家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Awesome, saves me lugging a huge box, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑsəm seɪvz mi ˈlʌɡɪŋ ə hjuːdʒ bɑks hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 太棒了，省得我搬大箱子，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, did you RSVP with the plus-one part?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ dɪd ju ɑɹ ɛs vi pi wɪð ðə plʌs wʌn pɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 那回覆邀請卡時有帶同伴嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm bringing Marco, he's so excited.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪm ˈbɹɪŋɪŋ ˈmɑɹkoʊ hiz soʊ ɪkˈsaɪtɪd/
dialogue.zh: 有，我帶 Marco 去，他超興奮的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He'll love the food, it's a fancy place.
dialogue.phonetic: /hil lʌv ðə fud ɪts ə ˈfænsi pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 他會愛上食物的，場地很高級。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I picked chicken for the meal, is that okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pɪkt ˈtʃɪkən fɚ ðə mil ɪz ðæt oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我餐點選了雞肉，可以吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's fine, they just need counts for catering.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts faɪn ðeɪ dʒʌst nid kaʊnts fɚ ˈkətɚɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，他們只需要統計人數給外燴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, should I mention Marco's nut allergy?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ʃʊd aɪ ˈmɛnʃən ˈmɑɹkoʊz nʌt ˈælɚdʒi/
dialogue.zh: 噢，我該提 Marco 對堅果過敏嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good catch! There's a notes box at the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kæʃ ðɛrz ə noʊts bɑks ət ði ɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 好眼力！最後面有備註欄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll write it in there, no problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl raɪt ɪt ɪn ðɛr noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 我會寫進去，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Was it stressing you out, the whole thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd wəz ɪt ˈstɛsɪŋ ju aʊt ðə hoʊl θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好。整件事讓你很緊張嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like crazy, I spent two hours on that site.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ˈkɹeɪzi aɪ spɛnt tu ˈaʊərz ɑn ðæt saɪt/
dialogue.zh: 超緊張的，我在那個網站花了兩小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Haha, totally normal, gift stress is real.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑhɑ ˈtoʊɾəli ˈnɔɹməl ɡɪft stɛs ɪz ˈɹiəl/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，很正常啦，選禮焦慮是真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much do you think I should give?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ du ju θɪŋk aɪ ʃʊd ɡɪv/
dialogue.zh: 你覺得我該出多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'd say thirty to fifty, you know, no pressure.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪd seɪ ˈθɜrti tə ˈfɪfti ju noʊ noʊ ˈpɹɛʃɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我大概說三十到五十，你知道，不用有壓力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty feels fair to me, so I'll do that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔɹti filz fɛr tə mi soʊ aɪl du ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 四十我覺得很合理，就這個吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Anything else on the wedding thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɛls ɑn ðə ˈwɛdɪŋ θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 完美。婚禮還有別的事要問嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, what should Marco and I wear?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm wʌt ʃʊd ˈmɑɹkoʊ ænd aɪ wɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我和 Marco 該穿什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dressy but not too much, just look at the invite.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɹɛsi bʌt nɑt tu mʌtʃ dʒʌst lʊk ət ði ɪnˈvaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 正式但不用太誇張，看邀請卡就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh right, it says semi-formal, got it.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ raɪt ɪt sɛz ˈsɛmi ˈfɔɹməl ɡɑɾ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 噢對了，上面寫半正式，知道了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The colors were sage and cream, very pretty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʌlərz wɚ seɪdʒ ænd krim ˈvɛɹi ˈpɹɪti/
dialogue.zh: 配色是鼠尾草綠和奶油色，很好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, um, I'm actually pretty excited now.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ʌm aɪm ˈæktʃuəli ˈpɹɪti ɪkˈsaɪtɪd naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，嗯，我其實現在還蠻興奮的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You should be! They're gonna have a great night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ʃʊd bi ðɛr ˈɡənə hæv ə ɡɹeɪt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你應該興奮的！他們會有超棒的一晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I know. Hey, you're in the wedding party, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ heɪ jʊɹz ɪn ðə ˈwɛdɪŋ ˈpɑɹti raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我知道。嘿，你是婚禮團隊的一員對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, I'm a groomsman, so I have to dance.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp aɪm ə ˈɡɹumsmən soʊ aɪ hæv tə dæns/
dialogue.zh: 對，我是伴郎，所以到時一定要跳舞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Haha, please don't promise me anything scary.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑhɑ pliz doʊnt ˈpɹɑmɪs mi ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ˈskɛɹi/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，拜託別承諾我什麼可怕的表演。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No promises! Anyway, it was fun helping you.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɹɑmɪsəz ˈɛniˌweɪ ɪt wəz fʌn ˈhɛlpɪŋ ju/
dialogue.zh: 不能保證啦！總之，能幫到你很快樂。

script.youtube_title: 【婚禮禮單💍】「直接買果汁機？」朋友教你聰明挑禮🎁｜聽完就會用英文討論婚禮清單🗣️｜60句沉浸式英語｜Wedding Gift Registry Chat
script.youtube_title_en: "Do I Just Buy the Blender?" — Figuring Out a Wedding Gift Registry with a Friend
script.youtube_description:
「直接買果汁機？」——收到婚禮邀請卡，卻搞不清楚禮單怎麼用？這一集是60句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在朋友家客廳，從找不到連結到搞定基金、RSVP、餐飲選擇，一路聊到底。

你會聽到：怎麼問禮單連結、看到太貴商品怎麼反應、共同基金怎麼分攤、禮物直接送到新家、回覆邀請卡的 plus-one 和備註過敏。

整段只用 A2 初級單字與美國人日常短句，um、well、so、haha 這些語感詞全部在。

不用背，多聽就會用。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡請訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en: "Do I just buy the blender?" — you got the wedding invite but the registry is confusing. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set in a friend's living room. You'll hear how to find the link, react to expensive items, use a group fund, confirm a plus-one, and note allergies on the RSVP. All in A2-level words with real American filler phrases. Chapter 4 is a line-by-line repeat workout. No memorizing needed, just listen often.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧婚禮禮單英文｜找連結・共同基金・RSVP同伴・過敏備註｜買果汁機太貴怎麼辦｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
收到婚禮邀請，但找不到禮單連結，果汁機要兩百塊，怎麼辦？共同基金算禮貌嗎？RSVP 要怎麼帶同伴？

這一集帶大家走進一位朋友的客廳，從問禮單連結、看到貴商品、討論共同基金、選金額、禮物送到新家，一路聽到 RSVP 與餐飲備註，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🎁 找禮單：It's on the wedding site, under gifts.
💰 共同基金：Can I just add, like, a small amount?
✉️ RSVP：So, did you RSVP with the plus-one part?
🥜 過敏備註：Oh, should I mention Marco's nut allergy?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再大聲說一遍。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。

下次收到婚禮邀請，你就能從容地搞定一切。
script.thumbnail_action: holding up a phone showing a blender listing
